auftrag.title: [Auftrag] Switch, add and forget Claude accounts from T3's screens

label: Criteria Review
bodySnapshot:
### Repository

~/shared/fastnd/t3code

### Blocked by

_No response_

### Settings

_No response_

### Behavioural requirements

- In the model picker, under the Claude models, the user sees which account is logged in on that Claude setup and that it applies to every chat on that setup.
- From the model picker the user can switch that setup to another remembered account. If turns are running on the setup, the user first confirms that they will be stopped; otherwise the switch starts at once.
- While a switch runs, the user sees that it is in progress and cannot start a second one.
- After a switch, everything that shows the Claude account or its usage shows the new account.
- A stopped turn is not continued by itself; the user continues the chat with a new message on the new account.
- When the logged-in account is not remembered yet, the user can remember it under a name of their choice, from the model picker and from the Claude provider settings.
- The user can add another Claude account to an existing setup without logging that setup out: they log in with the new account in the browser, name it, and T3 remembers it. This works also when the browser runs on a different device than T3.
- Adding an account can be started from the model picker, from the Claude provider settings, and from the "Add provider" dialog through an option "Share config with my existing Claude setup". That option appears only when a Claude setup already exists; when it is chosen, no second Claude provider is created.
- Cancelling or abandoning the adding of an account leaves no login behind.
- The Claude provider settings list the remembered accounts and show which one is active. From there the user can switch to an account and forget an account, after confirming. Forgetting the active account keeps the setup logged in.
- When T3 refuses an action, the user sees the reason in plain words.
- The account controls appear only where account switching is supported (Linux). Elsewhere they do not appear.
- Everything works from the web app and the desktop app, also when they are connected to T3 remotely. The mobile app is not part of this Auftrag.
- Not part of this Auftrag: a switch offer when a usage limit is hit, automatic switching, dedicated screens for rare errors, a command palette entry, live updates on other open devices.

### Purpose

- The backend Auftrag #2 made switching possible, but nobody can reach it yet. This Auftrag makes it usable every day.
- The model picker is where the user already chooses "which Claude"; putting the account there keeps the switch one step away when a usage limit stops work.
- One setup is shared by many chats; saying so in the picker prevents the wrong expectation that the account belongs to one chat.
- Switching stops running work in other chats, so it must not happen by a misclick. A switch can take several seconds; without visible progress users click twice or think it failed.
- Showing the old account's usage after a switch would make the user decide on wrong numbers.
- Switching back requires the current account to be remembered, so remembering must be offered where the user meets that gap.
- Adding an account by logging in over the current one would lose the current login. Adding it beside the setup keeps both. T3 is often used from another device, so the login must work from there too.
- Users who want "a second Claude" look in the "Add provider" dialog; a second provider on the same setup would always show the same account and only confuse them.
- A left-behind login is a credential lying around.
- Forget needs a home, and it removes something that only a fresh login brings back, hence the confirmation.
- The first version should run and be used before extras are added; many gaps are easier to judge once the basics work.
- This is a personal build; Linux is the only platform in use.

### Mocks

Design store, authored in artifacts/soerencoremans-t3code/auftrag-8/ in the Loop-Forge repository. SOURCE.md there lists the decisions behind each artboard and two open points.

- `ModelPickerAccount.dc.html`: the account row in the model picker. Closed, menu open, confirm, account not remembered, switching.
- `AddProviderShareConfig.dc.html`: the "Share config with my existing Claude setup" option in the "Add provider" dialog. Unticked, ticked, and the login step. The login step is a sketch; how the login is shown may differ.
- `ClaudeAccountsSettings.dc.html`: the accounts in the Claude provider settings. Normal, account not remembered, forget confirmation.

**The Auftrag wins on scope.** The mocks show the intended look and states, not every detail.

### No technical details

- [X] This Auftrag names no files, libraries, tables or architecture. That is the Gremium's job.

### Acceptance criteria

<details>
<summary>39 scenarios</summary>

Scenario AK-1: Model picker shows the logged-in Claude account for all chats
  Given a Claude setup on Linux logged in with the remembered account "Work"
  When the user opens the model picker and looks at the Claude models
  Then below the Claude models they see that "Work" is the logged-in account
  And they see that this account applies to every chat on that Claude setup
Serves: R1

Scenario AK-2: Switch from the model picker starts at once when no turns run
  Given a Claude setup logged in as the remembered account "Work"
  And a second remembered account "Private"
  And no turn is running on that setup
  When the user picks "Private" in the model picker's account row
  Then the switch to "Private" starts without asking for confirmation
Serves: R2

Scenario AK-3: Switch from the model picker asks first when turns run
  Given a Claude setup logged in as the remembered account "Work"
  And a second remembered account "Private"
  And a turn is running in one of the chats on that setup
  When the user picks "Private" in the model picker's account row
  Then they are asked to confirm that running turns will be stopped
  And the switch has not started yet
Serves: R2

Scenario AK-4: Declining the confirmation leaves the account unchanged
  Given the user has been asked to confirm a switch because a turn is running
  When they decline
  Then the setup is still logged in as "Work"
  And the running turn keeps running
Serves: R2

Scenario AK-5: Confirming the switch stops the running turns and switches
  Given the user has been asked to confirm a switch to "Private" because a turn is running
  When they confirm
  Then the running turn is stopped
  And the setup is logged in as "Private"
Serves: R2

Scenario AK-6: A running switch is shown as in progress
  Given a switch from "Work" to "Private" has started
  When the user looks at the model picker's account row before the switch finishes
  Then they see that a switch is in progress
Serves: R3

Scenario AK-7: A second switch cannot start while one is running
  Given a switch from "Work" to "Private" has started and not yet finished
  When the user tries to start another switch, from the model picker or from the Claude provider settings
  Then no second switch starts
  And the first switch finishes as "Private"
Serves: R3

Scenario AK-8: After a switch every account display shows the new account
  Given the setup has just been switched from "Work" to "Private"
  When the user looks at the model picker's account row and the Claude provider settings
  Then both show "Private" as the logged-in account
  And neither shows "Work" as logged in
Serves: R4

Scenario AK-9: After a switch the usage shown belongs to the new account
  Given "Work" has used most of its usage limit and "Private" has used little
  And the setup has just been switched from "Work" to "Private"
  When the user looks at the Claude usage shown in T3
  Then the usage shown is that of "Private"
  And the usage of "Work" is no longer shown
Serves: R4

Scenario AK-10: A turn stopped by a switch is not continued by itself
  Given a chat whose turn was stopped by a switch to "Private"
  When the switch has finished and the user sends nothing
  Then the chat does not continue on its own
Serves: R5

Scenario AK-11: The user continues a stopped chat with a new message on the new account
  Given a chat whose turn was stopped by a switch to "Private"
  When the user sends a new message in that chat
  Then the chat continues
  And the reply comes from the "Private" account
Serves: R5

Scenario AK-12: Model picker offers to remember an account that is not remembered yet
  Given a Claude setup logged in with an account T3 has not remembered yet
  When the user opens the model picker's account row
  Then they are offered to remember the account instead of a list of accounts to switch to
Serves: R6

Scenario AK-13: Remembering the logged-in account from the model picker
  Given a Claude setup logged in with an account T3 has not remembered yet
  When the user chooses to remember it from the model picker and names it "Work"
  Then the account is remembered as "Work"
  And the model picker shows "Work" as the logged-in account
Serves: R6

Scenario AK-14: Remembering the logged-in account from the Claude provider settings
  Given a Claude setup logged in with an account T3 has not remembered yet
  When the user chooses to remember it in the Claude provider settings and names it "Work"
  Then the account is remembered as "Work"
  And the settings list "Work" as the active account
Serves: R6

Scenario AK-15: Adding an account keeps the setup logged in
  Given a Claude setup logged in as the remembered account "Work"
  When the user adds another account, logs in with it in the browser and names it "Private"
  Then "Private" is remembered
  And the setup is still logged in as "Work"
Serves: R7

Scenario AK-16: Adding an account works when the browser is on another device
  Given T3 runs on one machine and the user's browser runs on a different device
  And a Claude setup logged in as the remembered account "Work"
  When the user adds another account, completes the login in that browser and names it "Private"
  Then "Private" is remembered
  And the setup is still logged in as "Work"
Serves: R7

Scenario AK-17: Adding an account can be started from the model picker
  Given a Claude setup on Linux
  When the user chooses to add an account from the model picker's account row
  Then the add-account login starts for that setup
Serves: R8

Scenario AK-18: Adding an account can be started from the Claude provider settings
  Given a Claude setup on Linux
  When the user chooses to add an account in the Claude provider settings
  Then the add-account login starts for that setup
Serves: R8

Scenario AK-19: "Add provider" offers to share config when a Claude setup exists
  Given a Claude setup already exists on Linux
  When the user opens the "Add provider" dialog and chooses Claude
  Then they see the option "Share config with my existing Claude setup"
Serves: R8

Scenario AK-20: "Add provider" hides the share option when no Claude setup exists
  Given no Claude setup exists yet
  When the user opens the "Add provider" dialog and chooses Claude
  Then the option "Share config with my existing Claude setup" is not shown
Serves: R8

Scenario AK-21: Sharing config adds an account and creates no second Claude provider
  Given exactly one Claude setup exists, logged in as "Work"
  When the user ticks "Share config with my existing Claude setup", logs in with another account and names it "Private"
  Then "Private" is remembered for the existing setup
  And there is still exactly one Claude provider
Serves: R8

Scenario AK-22: Cancelling the add-account login leaves no login behind
  Given the user has started adding an account and has not finished the login
  When they cancel
  Then no new account is remembered
  And no login for that attempt remains on the machine
Serves: R9

Scenario AK-23: Closing the add-account step without finishing leaves no login behind
  Given the user has started adding an account
  When they close the dialog or the app without cancelling
  Then no new account is remembered
  And no login for that attempt remains on the machine
Serves: R9

Scenario AK-24: An add-account attempt interrupted by a T3 restart leaves no login behind
  Given the user has started adding an account and has not finished the login
  When T3 restarts
  Then no login for that attempt remains on the machine once T3 is running again
Serves: R9

Scenario AK-25: Settings list the remembered accounts and mark the active one
  Given a Claude setup logged in as "Work" with "Work" and "Private" remembered
  When the user opens the Claude provider settings
  Then they see "Work" and "Private" listed
  And "Work" is marked as active
Serves: R10

Scenario AK-26: Switching from the Claude provider settings starts at once when no turns run
  Given a Claude setup logged in as "Work" with "Private" also remembered
  And no turn is running on that setup
  When the user chooses to switch to "Private" in the Claude provider settings
  Then the switch starts without asking for confirmation
  And once it finishes the settings mark "Private" as active
Serves: R10

Scenario AK-27: Forgetting an account asks for confirmation first
  Given a Claude setup with "Work" active and "Private" remembered
  When the user chooses to forget "Private" in the Claude provider settings
  Then they are asked to confirm before anything is forgotten
Serves: R10

Scenario AK-28: Confirming forget removes the account from the list
  Given the user has been asked to confirm forgetting "Private"
  When they confirm
  Then "Private" is no longer listed
  And "Private" is no longer offered for switching in the model picker
Serves: R10

Scenario AK-29: Declining forget keeps the account
  Given the user has been asked to confirm forgetting "Private"
  When they decline
  Then "Private" is still listed
Serves: R10

Scenario AK-30: Forgetting the active account keeps the setup logged in
  Given a Claude setup logged in as the remembered account "Work"
  When the user forgets "Work" and confirms
  Then the setup is still logged in with that account
  And the account is shown as not remembered, with the offer to remember it
Serves: R10

Scenario AK-31: A refused switch tells the user why in plain words
  Given a Claude program outside T3 is using the Claude setup
  When the user tries to switch to another remembered account
  Then the switch is refused and the setup stays on its current account
  And the user sees a plain-language reason that names no internal identifiers or commands
Serves: R11

Scenario AK-32: A refused add-account tells the user why in plain words
  Given the user is adding an account and the login fails or is refused
  When T3 reports the failure
  Then the user sees a plain-language reason that names no internal identifiers or commands
  And no new account is remembered
Serves: R11

Scenario AK-33: Account controls appear on Linux
  Given T3 runs on Linux with a Claude setup
  When the user opens the model picker's Claude models, the Claude provider settings and the "Add provider" dialog for Claude
  Then the account row, the accounts list and the share-config option are present
Serves: R12

Scenario AK-34: Account controls are hidden where switching is not supported
  Given T3 runs on a platform other than Linux with a Claude setup
  When the user opens the model picker's Claude models, the Claude provider settings and the "Add provider" dialog for Claude
  Then no account row, no accounts list and no share-config option is shown
  And no error about accounts is shown
Serves: R12

Scenario AK-35: Switching works from the web app connected remotely
  Given the web app connected to a T3 on another machine with "Work" active and "Private" remembered
  When the user switches to "Private" from the model picker
  Then the remote setup is logged in as "Private"
  And the web app shows "Private" as the logged-in account
Serves: R13

Scenario AK-36: The desktop app connected remotely lists the remote setup's accounts
  Given the desktop app connected to a T3 on another machine whose Claude setup has "Work" active and "Private" remembered
  When the user opens the Claude provider settings
  Then they see "Work" and "Private" listed
  And "Work" is marked as active
Serves: R13

Scenario AK-37: Hitting a usage limit neither offers nor performs a switch
  Given the active account "Work" hits its usage limit during a turn, with "Private" remembered
  When the turn ends with the usage-limit message
  Then no switch offer is shown with that message
  And the setup stays logged in as "Work"
Serves: R14

Scenario AK-38: Switching from the Claude provider settings asks first when turns run
  Given a Claude setup logged in as "Work" with "Private" also remembered
  And a turn is running in one of the chats on that setup
  When the user chooses to switch to "Private" in the Claude provider settings
  Then they are asked to confirm that running turns will be stopped
  And the switch has not started yet
Serves: R10

Scenario AK-39: Switching works from the desktop app connected remotely
  Given the desktop app connected to a T3 on another machine whose Claude setup has "Work" active and "Private" remembered
  When the user switches to "Private" in the Claude provider settings
  Then the remote setup is logged in as "Private"
  And the desktop app shows "Private" as the logged-in account
Serves: R13

</details>
